milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the light gray stained glass and face it to demonstrate visual discovery. The target is the freestanding glass pillar at spawn-relative (2, 1, 5), which is a 3-block tall column flanked by torches — the most prominent and closest glass feature in the scene. max_distance=8 ensures the player must approach within a reasonable viewing distance (not just stand anywhere), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is actually looking toward the glass.
